task.description:
WF-03 Step 5: Test execution for ISS-0209 / GH-533 fix.

Pre-checks (mandatory per TEST-RUNNER section of CLAUDE.md):
1. Backend services: docker-compose ps | grep -E 'keycloak|db'; curl Keycloak ready; psql BPM_TEST_DB_URL SELECT 1
2. Infrastructure: zig build migrate 2>&1 exits 0; psql SELECT count(*) FROM schema_migrations matches migrations/ count
3. python3 tools/lint_test_isolation.py tests/integration exits 0, no BLOCKER
4. zig build test-env-verify exits 0

If any pre-check fails: STOP, return FAIL with BLOCKER severity listing the failed checks. Do NOT attempt to start services.

If pre-checks pass:
- Run `zig build test --summary all` × 5 consecutive times. Each must exit 0 OR match the documented baseline (21 pre-existing failures documented in docs/issue-reports/ISS-0209-diagnosis.yaml).
- Verify: PASS only if test count is stable across all 5 runs (no new failures introduced).

Write results to tests/reports/report-<date>-WF03-GH533-20260807.yaml per docs/guides/test_developer_guide.md §9.

Complete handoff with PASS/FAIL.
acceptance_criteria: zig build test runs 5 times, each produces stable result
No new failures beyond documented baseline (21 PgError.AuthenticationFailed)

result.summary: Mandatory infrastructure pre-checks failed. Services and direct DB readiness passed, but migration authentication failed and test-env-verify reported C0, C1, C3, C4, and C6 failures, so the required five consecutive test runs were not validly executed.

issues.description: Test infrastructure unhealthy: BPM_TEST_DB_URL points to localhost:5433 while db_test publishes localhost:5434; zig build migrate exits with error.AuthenticationFailed; zig build test-env-verify exits 1 with C0, C1, C3, C4, and C6 failures.
The required five-run stability comparison against the documented 21-failure baseline was not performed because the mandatory infrastructure gate failed.

result.next_action: Route to ORCH for ADHOC BACKEND-DEV infrastructure repair and redispatch TEST-RUNNER.
